name: Catnip

schedule.notes: Pick a spot away from main paths — feline visitors will trample the surroundings.
Cut stems just before flowering for the strongest scent. Hang in shade to dry.

harvest.cues: Whole stems 8+ in, leaves still bright green, buds tight or just opening.
harvest.storageNotes: Dries excellently in bundles. Keeps a year in airtight jars.

varieties.name: True Catnip
varieties.notes: The cat-attracting one. Not as ornamental as Nepeta hybrids.

notes: Cat-magnet. If you have outdoor cats, expect rolling and trampling. Repels squash bugs and aphids when interplanted with cucurbits. Also a calming herbal tea for humans.
